official_definition: Spellsong - (Opponent's Turn) While you have a Song Magic card on your Field, at the start of each Step of your opponent's turn, return one opposing Spirit with equal or less BP than this Spirit to the bottom of the deck.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Spellsong] or [Spellsong: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Spellsong]", "give [Spellsong]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
